note: Hand-run operator mutation gate: node tools/mutation-adiri/gen.mjs writes the mutants (tools/mutation-adiri/mutants.json) over cfa1.ts, record.ts, chain.ts, sigs.ts, kind.ts and genesislink.ts; node tools/mutation-adiri/run.mjs applies each in memory against the unit tests and the quick vector subsets (per-file test map in run.mjs). Every survivor below is an equivalent mutant: the mutated program returns the same value or throws the same state for every input, for the reason given. Sites are file:line of the current sources; mutants.json holds the exact edit. Revision 2 (after the strict-hex pins, the wrap-free spine and the genesis link): the first revision's record.ts hex entries (the common.FromHex leniency) no longer exist, because the code they mutated is gone.
